blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-verified 2026-08-08 at Ethereum block 25712115 and BNB Chain block 114787010. The official inventory identifies Ethereum 0xc5d6a7b61d18afa11435a889557b068bb9f29930 and BNB Chain 0x8ba9da757d1d66c58b1ae7e2ed6c04087348a82d as sUSDD; both remained identical-size direct deployments with zero EIP-1967 implementation slots. Their verified SavingsUsdd source exposes ordinary ERC-20 transfers and allowance-gated ERC-4626 withdrawals, with no owner, role administration, pause, blacklist, denylist, seizure, or arbitrary-holder burn. The inherited finding comes solely from tracked parent usdd-tron-dao-reserve, whose 2026-08-10 all-chain reserve review resolves Upstream; sUSDD does not receive a direct holder-freeze flag.

oracleRisk.summary: sUSDD is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over USDD and has no borrower-owned collateral positions or local liquidation engine. Its required USDD parent carries the separately reviewed governed CDP oracle, auction, deficit, and shutdown branch.

branchApplicability.reviewer: OpenAI Codex W1b oracle applicability review
branchApplicability.rationale: sUSDD's ERC-4626 vault exchange rate values deposited USDD against shares for minting and redemption, so it is a price-sensitive top-level authority. The savings wrapper does not originate borrower debt or operate collateral-ratio liquidations; its USDD dependency preserves the parent exposure without local branch rows.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: The official sUSDD roster and both exact verified SavingsUsdd sources identify independent native Ethereum and BNB Chain wrappers, not canonical-sUSDD lock/mint receipts. Each immutable wrapper mints only against local USDD deposits and burns shares on local withdrawal; neither source has a bridge-message or privileged share-mint path. Their separate immutable Pots determine chain-local share-to-USDD conversion, so equal raw share units are not established as equal economic claims. No raw-share materiality enrollment, static supply share, historical external-escrow absence, or parent-USDD bridge exemption is claimed.
